blurb: 12-month equal-weight hold of the three highest-scoring high-growth compounders. Score uses ROE, margins, revenue/earnings growth, leverage, current ratio, PE/PEG, and insider/institutional ownership. No moving averages, RSI, or stage filters. Researched pack: revenue growth ≥20%, earnings growth ≥25%, ROE ≥12%, PE ≤60.
disclaimer: A 100% return in one year means doubling capital. That happened in one 12-month slice in this Nifty 200 sample (Sep 2023–Sep 2024) with a concentrated 3-name book; other years were far quieter. This is not a forecast. Yahoo statements cover about five fiscal years, lagged 90 days after year-end, so the first months of a 5-year window stay in cash until FY2022 numbers are treated as public. Max drawdown in sample is around 30%. Past backtests are not a guarantee.
